preReview.title: Knowles: Motivated Minnesota aiming to defy playoff odds
preReview.description: Minnesota United's hopes of reaching the playoffs rest on beating the San Jose Earthquakes, and Cameron Knowles is relishing the task.

preReview.title: Knowles: un Minnesota motivado quiere desafiar los pronósticos y clasificarse para las eliminatorias
preReview.description: El Minnesota United necesita vencer a los San Jose Earthquakes para clasificarse para las eliminatorias, un reto que Cameron Knowles afronta con entusiasmo.

preReview.title: Knowles: Minnesota motivato e pronto a sovvertire i pronostici nella corsa ai playoff
preReview.description: Le speranze di playoff del Minnesota United passano da una vittoria contro i San Jose Earthquakes e Cameron Knowles non vede l'ora di affrontare la sfida.

preReview.title: Knowles: Minnesota está motivado para contrariar os prognósticos na luta pela fase eliminatória
preReview.description: Para chegar à fase eliminatória, o Minnesota United precisa vencer o San Jose Earthquakes, e Cameron Knowles está motivado para encarar o desafio.

preReview.title: Knowles: Minnesota ist hoch motiviert und will den Playoff-Prognosen trotzen
preReview.description: Minnesota United muss die San Jose Earthquakes schlagen, um die Playoffs zu erreichen – Cameron Knowles freut sich auf die Aufgabe.

preReview.title: Knowles : Minnesota, plus motivé que jamais, veut déjouer les pronostics dans la course à la phase finale
preReview.description: Minnesota United doit battre les San Jose Earthquakes pour espérer se qualifier, un défi qui motive Cameron Knowles.
